_comment: Necropolis roster. `aspect` is the original's width-to-height at idle, measured with def_extract.py. `design` says what the creature looks like and carries no pose; `pose` is the stance for the front/side views only. The apose view supplies its own pose, because a mesh has to be riggable and a compact stance defeats pose estimation.
_moderation: FLUX rejects graphic decay wording ("rotting flesh", "dried blood", "bloated") as Violence. The undead entries are worded around it: desiccated, drawn tight, tattered. Keep it that way.
_style: Painterly stylised realism, not photoreal, detail subordinated to shape. Bold readable silhouette, three strong value masses with a wide range from near-black recesses to lit highlights, thick simplified forms. Weapons and equipment must contrast in value and hue against the body.

creatures.name: skeleton
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy skeleton warrior, bare bone, exaggerated skull and pelvis masses, thick simplified limbs, carrying a long sword with a dark oxidised iron blade and a bronze crossguard. The sword must be clearly darker than the bone -- at sprite size it only reads as a sword if it contrasts with the body. Desaturated grey-green ivory bone, dark iron, bronze.
creatures.pose: Hunched forward with the skull thrust ahead of the shoulders, sword low and angled down across the front of the body, arms near the ribs, short forward step.

creatures.name: skeletonWarrior
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy armoured skeleton warrior, rusted iron helm and shoulder plates over bare bone, a round shield and a sword. Desaturated bone and dark oxidised iron.
creatures.pose: Hunched forward, shield held close to the chest, sword low across the body.

creatures.name: walkingDead
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy undead figure, desiccated grey-green skin drawn tight over the frame, tattered rags. Sickly grey-green and dull brown.
creatures.pose: Arms hanging heavy and forward, head tilted to one side, shambling forward step, narrow slumped silhouette.

creatures.name: zombieLord
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy undead lord, larger and broader than a common one, desiccated grey-green skin over heavy shoulders, remnants of a leather harness. Sickly grey-green and dull brown.
creatures.pose: Arms hanging forward, slumped heavy stance.

creatures.name: wight
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy wight, a hooded spectral figure in a long ragged robe falling straight to a frayed hem with no legs visible, hollow dark void inside the hood, thin skeletal hands. Cold desaturated grey-blue and bone.
creatures.pose: Arms held close, robe hanging straight, very tall narrow silhouette.

creatures.name: wraith
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy wraith, a hooded spectral figure with a scythe, long ragged robe trailing to a frayed hem, hollow glowing eyes in shadow, gaunt skeletal hands. Cold desaturated grey-blue, pale bone, faint sickly green glow.
creatures.pose: Scythe held upright and close to the body, tall narrow silhouette.

creatures.name: vampire
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy vampire, gaunt pale noble in a high-collared cloak, clawed hands, sharp angular face. Desaturated pale skin, deep crimson and near-black.
creatures.pose: Cloak wrapped close to the body, arms drawn in, slight forward crouch.

creatures.name: vampireLord
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy vampire lord, taller and more imposing than a common vampire, gaunt pale noble in a heavy high-collared cloak with ornate dark armour at the shoulders, clawed hands. Desaturated pale skin, deep crimson, blackened silver.
creatures.pose: Cloak held close, hands raised, commanding upright posture.

creatures.name: lich
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy lich, skeletal sorcerer in a long heavy robe falling straight to the floor, skull face inside a deep hood, holding a short staff. Bone white, deep indigo robe, cold green spell light.
creatures.pose: One bony hand raised in a casting gesture close to the chest, staff held vertically, tall narrow silhouette.

creatures.name: powerLich
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy power lich, a taller more ornate skeletal sorcerer, heavy layered robe to the floor, elaborate collar and headdress framing a skull face, holding a staff. Bone white, deep indigo and gold, cold green spell light.
creatures.pose: Both bony hands raised close to the chest channelling energy, staff vertical, tall narrow silhouette.

creatures.name: blackKnight
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy black knight in full blackened plate armour with a closed helm, mounted on a skeletal undead warhorse, carrying a long sword. Blackened steel, dark crimson caparison, bone.
creatures.pose: Sword held low along the horse's flank, horse standing in a short stride with head low, rider compact on the saddle.

creatures.name: dreadKnight
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy dread knight in heavy ornate blackened plate with a horned closed helm, mounted on a skeletal undead warhorse, carrying a sword. Blackened steel, dark crimson, bone, faint cold glow in the visor.
creatures.pose: Sword raised close to the shoulder, horse in a short stride with head low.

creatures.name: boneDragon
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy bone dragon, a skeletal dragon with tattered membrane stretched between exposed wing bones, skull head with empty sockets, spined tail. Grey-green ivory bone and dark tattered membrane.
creatures.pose: Standing on all fours, wings folded close to the body, long neck lowered forward, tail curled in.

creatures.name: ghostDragon
creatures.design: Stylised fantasy ghost dragon, a spectral translucent dragon with tattered ghostly wings, hollow glowing eyes, trailing wisps at the tail. Cold desaturated grey-green translucence, faint inner glow.
creatures.pose: Standing on all fours, wings folded close to the body, long neck lowered forward.
